dedupe_keys.name: methane production from anaerobic pre treatment of municipal wastewater combined with olive mill wastewater a demonstration study

description: A demonstration-scale 21-cubic-metre advanced anaerobic reactor pretreats municipal wastewater at the Karmiel plant in Israel. The study runs 100 cubic metres per day of municipal wastewater with 0.5 cubic metres per day of olive-mill wastewater to simulate an agro-industrial discharge. The authors report tolerance of the mixture with removal above 50 percent for total COD and 18–47 percent for polyphenols, alongside biogas recovery. Temperature and organic loading affect performance. These outcomes concern the documented demonstration; they do not establish universal response to discharge shocks or quantify whole-plant energy savings. Related project collections may contain overlapping observations. The source documents a water quality treatment or recovery study. The source authors provide this description through Zenodo, whose deposit declares CC BY 4.0 and public document access. Geographic and temporal coverage remain limited to the cases or observations explicitly described. Only metadata and file descriptors were reviewed; no document, measurements, model archive or code was read. Related components retain their source identities and uncertain experimental overlap.
